title: Sketched least squares and subspace embeddings

items.title: Rank-aware sketch-and-solve least squares
items.statement: Apply a supplied sketch S to A and b, call the rank-thresholded SVD least-squares routine on (SA,Sb) at threshold zero with a finite sweep budget, and return a status, rank evidence, sketched and physical residuals, and a separate solve-error certificate field.

items.title: Oblivious squared-norm subspace embeddings
items.statement: Define fixed-subspace and oblivious (epsilon,delta) l2 embeddings using the squared-norm (1±epsilon) inequality, and distinguish the fixed-subspace probability from simultaneous preservation of every subspace.

items.title: Right preconditioner from the reduced QR factor of a sketch
items.statement: Given a reduced QR factorization SA=QR with nonsingular R, define the sketch-based right preconditioner P=R^(-1); state when it is defined and leave rank/factorisation failures explicit.

items.title: Row leverage scores of a finite-dimensional subspace
items.statement: Define the row leverage score ell_i(U)=||e_i*Q||_2^2 from an orthonormal basis Q of a d-dimensional subspace U of K^n; its basis independence and normalisation are proved by the listed justified-by supplier.

items.title: A sphere net controls a real or complex Hermitian operator norm
items.statement: A 1/4-net of the unit sphere in K^d has size at most 9^d over R and 9^(2d) over C, and for Hermitian H its largest absolute quadratic form on the net is at least ||H||_2/2.

items.title: Squared-norm concentration for real and normalized complex Gaussians
items.statement: For m independent standard real or variance-one normalized complex Gaussian scalars and 0<t<1, P(|m^(-1) sum_j |g_j|^2-1|≥t)≤2 exp(-m t^2/8), with the Gaussian integral and Chernoff calculation supplied locally.

items.title: Leverage scores are basis-independent and sum to the dimension
items.statement: For any orthonormal basis Q of U, ell_i=||e_i*Q||_2^2 is basis-independent, 0≤ell_i≤1, sum_i ell_i=dim U, and ell_i=0 exactly for a zero i-th row of Q.

items.title: A converged exact sketch-and-solve run returns a sketch minimizer
items.statement: If the zero-threshold SVD solver called by sketch-and-solve converges in exact arithmetic, the returned vector is the unique minimum-norm minimizer of ||S(Ax-b)||_2.

items.title: An embedded QR right preconditioner has controlled singular values
items.statement: For full-column-rank A and an epsilon embedding of Ran(A), the reduced QR of SA has nonsingular R and P=R^(-1) gives singular values of AP between 1/sqrt(1+epsilon) and 1/sqrt(1-epsilon).

items.title: With-replacement leverage-score row sampling and rescaling
items.statement: For orthonormal Q, probabilities pi_i≥beta ell_i/d, and sample count m, draw m indices independently with replacement and place e_i*/sqrt(m pi_i) in the corresponding sketch rows; zero-probability rows necessarily have zero leverage.

items.title: Gaussian sketches embed a fixed subspace at the additive dimension rate
items.statement: For a fixed d-dimensional real or complex subspace, S=G/sqrt(m) with iid standard real or variance-one normalized complex Gaussian entries is an (epsilon,delta) embedding when m≥192 epsilon^(-2)(d+log(1/delta)); the proof uses local scalar tails, finite nets, union bounds, and Hermitian norm transfer.

items.title: Embedding span(A,b) gives the sketch-and-solve residual factor
items.statement: If 0<epsilon<1 and S preserves squared norms within 1±epsilon on span(Ran(A),b), an exact sketch minimizer satisfies ||Axhat-b||_2^2≤((1+epsilon)/(1-epsilon)) min_x ||Ax-b||_2^2.

items.title: Leverage-score row sampling embeds the column space
items.statement: For d≥1, beta∈(0,1], epsilon,delta∈(0,1), and pi_i≥beta ell_i/d, with replacement leverage sampling embeds Ran(Q) with probability at least 1-delta if m≥8 d log(2d/delta)/(beta epsilon^2); for delta≤1/2, m≥16 d log(d/delta)/(beta epsilon^2) suffices. The local proof derives the leverage-sample variance and applies the published matrix-Bernstein supplier.

title: Sketched least squares and subspace embeddings — Examples

items.title: Embedding Ran(A) alone does not control the sketch-and-solve residual
items.statement: Refute the claim that embedding Ran(A) alone yields the ((1+epsilon)/(1-epsilon)) residual-square factor by the exact 2-dimensional example A=e_1, b=e_1+e_2, S=[1,1], epsilon=1/4.

items.title: Zero leverage rows and a maximally coherent one-dimensional design
items.statement: For Q=e_1 in R^3, compute leverage scores (1,0,0), coherence 3, exact leverage sampling, and the failure of one uniform rescaled row sample.

items.title: An exact two-row sketch for a three-row regression problem
items.statement: For A=(1,1,1)^T, b=e_1, and S with rows (1,1,1)/sqrt(3) and (2,-1,-1)/sqrt(6), compute the exact original and sketched least-squares minimizer x=1/3 and residual-square 2/3.
